bio.text: Craig Goldman is serving his first term in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Texas's 12th Congressional District, which includes parts of Tarrant and Parker counties.

He is a fourth-generation Fort Worth native and served twelve years in the Texas House of Representatives, including as chairman of the House Committee on Energy Resources and of the House Republican Caucus.
Before public office he worked for nearly a decade at his family's gourmet food and wine store in Fort Worth, and he holds a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Texas at Austin.
